memories.content:
Face-Trust Codebase Analysis Complete

PROJECT OVERVIEW:
- FaceTrust: AI-powered web app analyzing facial images for trustworthiness scores
- Entertainment/research tool that evaluates perceived trustworthiness, honesty, and reliability
- Uses Anthropic's Claude AI (specifically Claude Sonnet 4.5) for facial analysis
- Client-side image processing with secure API communication
- Dual deployment: Vercel (frontend + serverless API) + Express server option

TECH STACK:
Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite
Styling: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui components
State Management: TanStack Query v5.56.2
Routing: React Router DOM v6.26.2
Form Handling: React Hook Form v7.53.0
Charting: Recharts v2.12.7
Icons: Lucide React
Analytics: Google Analytics integration
Dev Tools: ESLint, TypeScript ESLint

Backend Options:
- Vercel Serverless Functions (api/analyze-face.js, api/test-env.js)
- Express.js server (server/index.js) - Node.js based alternative

KEY DIRECTORIES:
- src/ - Frontend React application
  - components/ - Reusable UI (ImageUpload, ScoreMeter, GoogleAnalytics)
  - pages/ - Routes (Index, Results, NotFound)
  - hooks/ - useAnalytics, useToast, useMobile
  - lib/ - env.ts config, utils.ts
  - utils/ - shareImage.ts for generating share-friendly images

- api/ - Vercel serverless functions
  - analyze-face.js - Main analysis endpoint
  - test-env.js - Environment debugging

- server/ - Express.js backend (optional)
  - index.js - Express app with /api/analyze-face endpoint
  - config.js - Configuration management

API MODEL: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929)
- Max tokens: 800
- Temperature: 0.3 (precise, deterministic)
- Takes base64 image input
- Returns JSON with score, honesty, reliability, explanation

BUILD/SCRIPTS:
- npm run dev - Vite dev server (port 8080)
- npm run build - Production build to dist/
- npm run build:dev - Dev mode build
- npm run lint - ESLint
- npm run preview - Preview production build

ENVIRONMENT:
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY - Required for Vercel deployment
VITE_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID - Google Analytics (defaults to G-GLHB5EDQ0W)
VITE_API_BASE_URL - Optional API endpoint override
VITE_SITE_URL - Site URL (defaults to facetrust.info)
VITE_DEV_MODE, VITE_DEBUG - Optional dev flags

ROUTES:
/ - Index page (image upload + analysis)
/results - Results display with scores and explanation
/* - 404 Not Found

API ENDPOINTS:
POST /api/analyze-face - Analyze image (requires image base64 in body)
GET /api/test-env - Test environment variables (Vercel only)

DEPLOYMENT:
- Primary: Vercel (frontend at facetrust.info + serverless functions)
- Alternative: Express server on custom port
- Vercel config has 30s timeout for analyze-face, 10s for test-env

UNIQUE PATTERNS:
- Facial analysis prompt using FACS (Facial Action Coding System)
- Evaluates eyes, facial muscles, symmetry, micro-expressions, psychological indicators
- Fallback scoring when AI response fails to parse
- Canvas-based image generation for sharing results
- Comprehensive error handling with environment debugging
- Google Analytics event tracking integrated throughout
- CORS enabled for cross-origin requests
